test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An amount of ₹2,00,000 is invested at 10% per annum compound interest. After 1 year, the investor withdraws 20,000 from the balance. What will be the total amount remaining in the account at the end of the 2nd year?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 200000

Rate of interest = 10%

Amount withdrawn after 1 year = 20000

Total time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound amount = Principal × (1 + Rate ÷ 100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount after 1 year = 200000 × (1 + 10 ÷ 100)

⇒ Amount after 1 year = 200000 × 1.10

⇒ Amount after 1 year = 220000

⇒ Balance after withdrawal = 220000 − 20000

⇒ Balance = 200000

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 200000 × (1 + 10 ÷ 100)

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 200000 × 1.10

⇒ Amount after 2nd year = 220000

**∴ The correct answer is 220000.**
